const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /tmp/updates-browse-luna.md <<'EOF'
# Updates browse design

## Current ownership

`+page.server.ts` calls `loadUpdates`, whose server adapter validates the complete monthly snapshot and returns typed `EntityUpdate[]` for both entity kinds. `/updates/+page.svelte` owns local category selection and renders `ResultRow`s; `updates.ts` owns category presentation metadata and UTC date formatting. `CategoryWheel` owns only generic SVG/button presentation: caller options supply path, rim, label positions and quadrant origin, while the component hard-codes a 142px square button. Its reduced-motion rule and the page's 250ms board entry animation are already in place. Keep ordering and visible-window logic in the updates feature; keep wheel shape geometry generic and backward-compatible.

## Shape proposal

Extend `CategoryWheelOption` with optional `buttonWidth` and `buttonHeight` (default both to 142). Use them for button box dimensions; existing `path`, `rimPath`, and transforms remain untouched, so ranking quadrants are unchanged. Updates options use 142×284 boxes and two closed half-disc paths, translated to x=0 and x=142 in SVG and CSS clipping; corresponding rim paths trace each outer semicircular arc. Position each label within its half. This keeps geometry caller-authored, preserves the existing option API defaults, and makes the hit area match the visible half. Avoid a special `shape` enum: it would make the component derive paths and label geometry it does not own.

## State and ordering

In `updates.ts`, define `UpdateSort = "newest" | "oldest" | "alphabetical"` and a pure `sortUpdates(rows, sort)` helper. In the page, hold `sort` (initial `newest`) and `visibleCount` (initial 10); derive the sorted category rows and slice to `visibleCount`. On category or sort changes, reset `visibleCount = 10`. A `Show more` button increments by 10, capped at row count; omit it when all rows are shown. Newest/oldest compare parsed registration timestamps at full precision, then compare names ascending using a deterministic case-insensitive collator, then IDs ascending. Alphabetical compares names with that same collator, then IDs. Do not reverse a sorted array for oldest-first, since that would invert ties. Use an existing native `<select>` for sort choice and existing `Button` for Show more; add no helper copy.

## SSR and behavior checks

The full typed snapshot can remain in SSR data, but render only the initial ten rows in server HTML. Tests should assert newest default/order, exact older-first inverse with stable alphabetical ties, alphabetical mode, category/sort reset, ten-row increments and hidden terminal button, SSR first-ten rows, profile links/counts/date preservation, and keyboard operation. Keep the current reduced-motion and 250ms animation checks; add wheel geometry assertions for half-height button bounds and retain ranking wheel gallery coverage to guard default quadrants.
EOF
